errors.evidence: The description states the final accuracy for the Llama3-3B line (at a compression factor of 5) is approximately 52%, but the chart shows the value is approximately 39%.

errors.text_span: A purple line, marked "Llama3-3B", begins at approximately 64% accuracy at a compression factor of 1, and decreases to approximately 52% accuracy at a compression factor of 5. A darker purple line, marked “Llama3-8B”, begins at approximately 68% accuracy at a compression factor of 1, and decreases to approximately 55% accuracy at a compression factor of 5.
errors.evidence: The description swaps the identities of the Llama3-3B and Llama3-8B lines. The Llama3-8B line (top, purple) starts at 70% and ends around 43%. The Llama3-3B line (middle, mauve) starts at ~63% and ends around 39%. The description incorrectly assigns values like 68% and 55% to the Llama3-8B line, and 64% and 52% to the Llama3-3B line.
